'''Malan son of [[Senar]]''' was an [[Ogier]] who lived shortly after the [[Breaking of the World]].

==History==
Malan's son [[Aran]] was born in {{ab|50}}, and would go on to become an acclaimed Ogier writer. Given his son's birth date, it is likely that Malan was born during the Breaking itself.{{ref/book|bwb}}
